name: friedman
comment: Sig: [p, Q, df] = friedman(x, reps). Friedman nonparametric two-way ANOVA by ranks: rank the k treatments (cols) within each of the n blocks (rows), Q = [12/(n*k*(k+1)) * sum(Rj^2) - 3*n*(k+1)] / C, tie correction C = 1 - sum(t^3-t)/(n*(k^3-k)), p = 1 - chi2cdf(Q, k-1). numkit returns the statistic+df, not MATLAB's display (tbl, stats); the p-value (validated here) matches MATLAB exactly. Fixes bugs/stats/friedman (was undefined). Verified vs MATLAB R2025b: friedman([1 2 3;2 3 4;3 4 5;1 3 5],1)=0.0183156 (Q=8, no ties), friedman([7 9 8;6 5 7;9 7 6;8 8 9;5 6 5],1)=0.8464817 (ties). reps>1 averages replicate rows per block.
